Cryptography

Collisione di hash

An event where two different inputs produce the same output hash value from a cryptographic hash function, undermining data integrity.

Questions and answers

What is Collisione di hash?

In this glossary, Collisione di hash refers to: An event where two different inputs produce the same output hash value from a cryptographic hash function, undermining data integrity.

How is Collisione di hash used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "La scoperta di collisioni di hash in MD5 e SHA-1 ha spinto la migrazione verso algoritmi più sicuri nella PKI."
